statements.status_notes: Cilium 1.18.x images ship google.golang.org/grpc@v1.74.2 (upstream go.mod). Bumping grpc to >=1.79.3 for CVE-2026-33186 breaks upstream operator unit tests (e.g. TestUpdateUsedCIDIsReverted in operator/pkg/ciliumidentity) during the image build. Investigating a safe bump path; other minor lines bump grpc via the definition pipeline.
